items.name: freeCodeCamp
items.summary: freeCodeCamp是一个开源教育平台，提供全面的编程、计算机科学和数学学习课程。该项目包含交互式编程课程、认证体系和学习者社区支持，涵盖JavaScript、Node.js、React和D3等技术。作为非营利性项目，它通过免费的在线资源和协作学习环境，致力于让全球用户都能获得编程教育机会。平台采用开放源代码模式，允许用户贡献和改进课程内容。
items.summary_en: freeCodeCamp is an open-source educational platform providing a comprehensive curriculum for learning programming, computer science, and mathematics. The project offers interactive coding lessons, certifications, and a supportive community for learners. It covers technologies including JavaScript, Node.js, React, and D3. As a nonprofit initiative, it aims to make coding education accessible to everyone worldwide through its free online resources and collaborative learning environment.

items.name: react
items.summary: React 是由 Facebook 开发的 JavaScript 库，专门用于构建用户界面，特别是网页应用程序。它采用声明式编程范式，允许开发者创建可复用的 UI 组件。React 能够在数据变化时高效地更新和渲染组件，为复杂界面提供优异的性能表现。该库支持 Web 和原生移动应用开发，通过 React Native 扩展了其跨平台能力。
items.summary_en: React is a JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces, particularly for web applications. It enables developers to create reusable UI components using a declarative programming approach. React efficiently updates and renders components when data changes, providing optimal performance for complex interfaces. The library supports both web and native mobile application development through React Native.

items.name: vue
items.summary: Vue.js 是一个用于构建用户界面的渐进式 JavaScript 框架。此仓库包含 Vue 2 版本，其核心库专注于视图层，具有易于上手的特点，生态系统库处理其他需求。Vue 采用基于组件的架构和声明式渲染，使用虚拟 DOM。请注意 Vue 3 的开发已移至单独的 vuejs/core 仓库。Vue 2 提供了响应式数据绑定和组件系统，支持单文件组件开发模式。
items.summary_en: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. This repository contains Vue 2, which features an approachable core library focused on the view layer only, with ecosystem libraries handling additional needs. Vue uses a component-based architecture and declarative rendering with a virtual DOM. Note that Vue 3 development has moved to a separate repository at vuejs/core.

items.summary_en: TensorFlow is an open-source machine learning framework developed for building and deploying ML models across various platforms. It supports multiple programming languages with Python as the primary interface. The framework provides tools for neural network development, distributed computing, and production deployment. It includes comprehensive libraries for deep learning, numerical computation, and model optimization, enabling researchers and developers to create scalable machine learning applications.

items.name: ohmyzsh

items.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations. It simplifies shell configuration management and enhances command-line productivity through extensive plugin and theme options.
